picks.headline: Data Poisoning Injects Silent Backdoors into Open-Source Robotics Models
picks.why: Demonstrates how minimal training data contamination induces complete denial-of-service in vision-language-action robotics like smolVLA.
picks.title: !Imperio, smolVLA: The Implications of Data Poisoning on Open Source Robotics

picks.headline: Nemotron-Labs Hybrid MoE Compression Yields 8x Concurrency on H100
picks.why: Multi-stage compression of Nemotron-3-Super enables 1M-token context handling while doubling B200 throughput.
picks.title: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Compressing Hybrid MoE LLMs

picks.headline: Full-Stack FP4 Enables Stable End-to-End 4-Bit LLM Pretraining
picks.why: Solves quantization instability in projections, optimizers, and attention to reach near-BF16 pretraining efficiency.
picks.title: Full-Stack FP4: Stable LLM Pretraining with Quantized Projections, Optimizers, and Attention

picks.headline: Unified Cross-Modal Attack Measures Training Data Exposure Across Modalities
picks.why: Establishes a modality-agnostic likelihood ratio test for black-box membership inference across text and image models.
picks.title: One Framework for All: Cross-Modal Membership Inference for Generative Models

picks.headline: Auto Compiler Converts Live LLM Agent Behaviors into Deterministic Code
picks.why: Distills stochastic agent trajectories into verified programs, drastically cutting inference costs and execution variance.
picks.title: Auto: The AGI Compiler

papers.headline: Latent Misalignment Persona in Qwen2.5 Can Be Transplanted or Inverted
papers.why: Identifies a latent vector direction driving emergent misalignment that can be dynamically manipulated or neutralized.
papers.title: Transplanting, inverting, and preventing a misalignment persona: method-conditional emergent misalignment in Qwen2.5

papers.headline: Code LLMs Suffer Irrecoverable Semantic Collapse from Incorrect Instructions
papers.why: Reveals models exhibit blind obedience to erroneous user instructions even after identifying the instruction as incorrect.
papers.title: Obey, Diverge, Collapse: Blind Obedience to Incorrect Instructions Drives Code LLMs to Irrecoverable Code Semantic Collapse

papers.headline: Lagrangian Dual Flows Enable Constrained Generative Flow Matching Without Optimization
papers.why: Guarantees non-linear constraint satisfaction during generative sampling without requiring expensive runtime optimization steps.
papers.title: Constrained Flow Matching via Lagrangian Dual Flows
